title: Offline Learning of Reserve Prices from Censored Bids
abstract: arXiv:2611.06067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study how a seller can learn a reserve price for a second-price auction from censored historical bid data. Because values below past reserves are unobserved, even unlimited data may not reveal which reserve earns the most revenue. Under a monotone hazard rate (MHR) assumption, we characterize exactly when an optimal reserve is identified, even though the value distribution may not be: either revenue has not yet begun to fall at the lowest historical reserve, so the best reserve lies among the observed bids, or the censored fraction is as large as MHR allows, which pins down the entire distribution. When identification fails, we derive the reserve that minimizes worst-case revenue regret over distributions consistent with the data, and prove that this unique minimax reserve and its regret depend on just two observable quantities: the censored fraction and the hazard just above the lowest historical reserve. translated_title: 从删失出价中离线学习保留价格
translated_abstract: 我们研究卖家如何从删失的历史出价数据中学习二价拍卖的保留价格。由于低于过去保留价格的估值是不可观测的，即使是无限的数据也可能无法揭示哪个保留价格能带来最多收入。在单调风险率（MHR）假设下，我们精确刻画了最优保留价格何时可以被识别——即使价值分布本身可能无法被识别：要么收入在最低历史保留价格处尚未开始下降，因此最优保留价格位于观测到的出价之中；要么删失比例达到MHR所允许的最大值，此时整个分布被完全确定。当识别失败时，我们推导出在与数据一致的所有分布上最小化最坏情况收入遗憾的保留价格，并证明这一唯一的极小极大遗憾保留价格及其遗憾值仅取决于两个可观测的量：删失比例和略高于最低历史保留价格处的风险率。当有N个历史竞……
tldr: 本文在单调风险率假设下精确刻画了从删失出价数据中识别二价拍卖最优保留价格的条件，并在识别失败时给出仅依赖删失比例和最低历史保留价格处风险率这两个可观测量的极小极大遗憾最优保留价格。
en_tdlr: Under the monotone hazard rate assumption, this paper precisely characterizes when the optimal reserve price for a second-price auction is identifiable from censored bid data, and derives a unique minimax-regret reserve price that, when identification fails, depends only on two observable quantities: the censored fraction and the hazard rate just above the lowest historical reserve.
